prompt.text:
Implement a CommonJS module exporting exactly `{ advanceToken }`.

`advanceToken(state)` computes one discrete step for a token moving inside a rectangular area. `state` must be a plain object containing integer `width` and `height` from 1 through 10000, integer coordinates `x` and `y` within `0..width - 1` and `0..height - 1`, and velocities `dx` and `dy`, each exactly `-1`, `0`, or `1`.

Add each velocity to its coordinate. If a proposed coordinate leaves the area, reverse that velocity component and move one cell in the reversed direction instead. For an axis of length 1, its coordinate remains 0 and that velocity component becomes 0. Both axes are handled independently. Return a new object containing exactly `{ width, height, x, y, dx, dy }`.

Throw `TypeError` for any malformed value, including missing fields, arrays, fractions, or out-of-range coordinates. Do not mutate or return the input object. Extra input properties are ignored. Use only the JavaScript standard library.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
